decisions.reason: The page 11 photo crop adjustment does not change the document's general layout, spacing, coverage, or background-treatment requirements.
Making the tree more visible in one photo does not change the Agua Arc identity or brand assets applied to the proposal.
The source concerns only a page 11 photo crop and does not alter any table content or integration requirement.
The photo crop request does not modify proposal narrative content, section order, or section inclusion.
The requested adjustment is for a photo on page 11 and does not change the one-page cover letter or its image-relocation rules.
The page 11 photo crop does not change the required PDF format, file count, export quality, or email compatibility.
The photo crop adjustment is unrelated to hyperlink functionality in the saved proposal.
Requesting a photo adjustment does not change Canva access, editability, ownership, or asset policy.
The source explicitly concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and has no effect on the TPEC proposal design requirement.
The source supplies an individual photo correction but does not change the number of revision rounds or the existing trigger for consolidated final revisions.
Zooming out within a page 11 photo does not necessarily change the proposal page limit or its page-reduction approach.
The photo crop request contains no change to the draft, revision, submission, or delivery deadlines.
